title: AC1024 associative constrained-rigid-set node
scope: Decode the observed AC1024 version-0 inline AcConstrainedRigidSet body transactionally; preserve incomplete nodes/groups raw and retain strict document-level refusal until required associative ownership, graph closure, output and readback are complete.

independentLayoutSource.layout: The pinned reader/writer profile orders the node-specific soft-pointer handle, geometry node ID (BL), reserved flag (B), sixteen bit doubles, geometry-ID count (BL), then geometry IDs (BL). The independent source confirms field order; physical boundaries and values below come from the local AC1024 witness.

autodeskClass.meaning: AcConstrainedRigidSet is a constrained rigid-set node belonging to an associative 2D constraint group.

autodeskMethods.meaning: The class exposes constrained geometry membership and a transform.

autodeskConstructor.meaning: The constructor accepts a transform relative to the owning group's workplane; no matrix row/column convention is inferred by this decoder.

odaSpecification.result: ODA v5.4.1 contains the applicable bit-stream primitive definitions but no class-specific RigidSet body layout. The class-specific field order is corroborated by the pinned reader and the physical AC1024 trace.

sourceProfile.boundaryConfirmation: The complete civil group now parses through 147/147 nodes, including the following AcConstrainedArc node 873. The architectural witness independently remains complete at 174/174 nodes.

independentRun.result: Independently recognizes group 777 and one AcConstrainedRigidSet. Its 148-node count includes the reader's existing empty placeholder convention; libdxfrw's source-ordered node count is 147. This run corroborates class membership, not the RigidSet payload values.

implementation.profile: Version-0 inline profile observed in AC1024: soft-pointer code 4/reference 0, geometry node ID, reserved flag, sixteen finite bit doubles retained in wire order, bounded geometry-ID count and IDs. Existing enum values are preserved by appending DataKind::RigidSet. No row/column matrix convention or writer serialization is added.
implementation.failureBehavior: Parsing uses independent body and handle probes. A wrong handle role, truncated transform, negative count or truncated ID list leaves the node raw and group partial without committing body/handle positions; a following generated sentinel object remains recoverable.
generatedControls: Valid generated RigidSet verifies the null soft-pointer role, transform and geometry IDs [767, 769, 771], followed by an implicit-point node to prove handle-stream alignment.
Wrong handle role remains raw/partial and the following object recovers.
Truncated transform remains raw/partial and the following object recovers.
Truncated geometry-ID list remains raw/partial and the following object recovers.
Negative geometry-ID count remains raw/partial and the following object recovers.
implementation.outputBehavior: No graph serializer was added. Strict export still refuses with dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized; no DXF is created.
implementation.abiNote: DRW_AssociativeConstraintNode layout changed; ABI compatibility remains an open P8 qualification item.

civilNormalAndAsan.result: Byte-identical source traces; RigidSet node 768 ends at body bit 26560 and handle bit 89110; all 147 civil nodes decode. The export preflight refuses the incomplete associative graph and no DXF is created. No sanitizer diagnostics.

architecturalNormal.result: The architectural group remains complete at 174/174 nodes; strict export is refused and no DXF is created.

nextAction: Resolve source-required roles, types and owners for RigidSet geometry IDs 767, 769 and 771, then continue recursive associative graph closure and output/readback. Keep strict export refused until the complete reachable graph is serialized and independently read back.
